deliverables.title: One-page scope and success criteria
deliverables.acceptance: Name the one-UE baseline, five backlog items, constraints and Friday proof.

deliverables.title: Starting knowledge and reuse inventory
deliverables.acceptance: Record four evidence-based skill checks and specific material worth reusing.

deliverables.title: Chosen lab environment and topology
deliverables.acceptance: Name the Linux path and draw all logical links with collision-checked lab addressing.

deliverables.title: Environment and capability manifest
deliverables.acceptance: Record OS/kernel/resources, networking mode and TUN/transport checks without claiming untested support.

deliverables.title: Pinned version and dependency ledger
deliverables.acceptance: Record full revisions, compiler/build tools, documentation references and known compatibility gaps.

deliverables.title: Ready-for-build state and restore notes
deliverables.acceptance: Explain source/config/log locations, snapshot or recovery method and reboot persistence.

deliverables.title: Open5GS build and test report
deliverables.acceptance: Record exact revision, build/test commands, outcomes and separate failures/skips.

deliverables.title: UERANSIM build report
deliverables.acceptance: Record source revision, commands, binary/help checks and untested runtime behavior.

deliverables.title: Configuration agreement checklist
deliverables.acceptance: Reconcile core/gNB/UE settings with synthetic subscriber provisioning; publish no keys.

deliverables.title: Core/gNB readiness and UE registration evidence
deliverables.acceptance: Link one run and show readiness, gNB setup and registration as separate evidenced results.

deliverables.title: PDU session and traffic evidence
deliverables.acceptance: Show session/address evidence plus return traffic through the UE/UPF path, excluding host-route bypass.

deliverables.title: Annotated golden-run timeline
deliverables.acceptance: Provide eight observed/inferred/unavailable timeline rows with precise evidence references.

deliverables.title: One source-code path explained
deliverables.acceptance: Link file/function/commit, connect it to an observed event, and state runtime-proof limitations.

deliverables.title: Controlled repeat and runbook
deliverables.acceptance: Provide starting state, exact sequence and second-run comparison, including failures.

deliverables.title: Week 1 demonstration and reflection
deliverables.acceptance: Link the supported results, five-minute demo outline and honest final outcome with remaining gaps.
